channel.title: Codier · Working with AI agents
channel.description: Field notes from building and working with AI agents: real deliveries, failures, and judgment calls.

item.title: I Dismantled My Own Agent Company
item.description: I defined departments, responsibilities, and reporting lines for a group of AI agents. The organization started producing process instead of product. Now I’m starting again with one agent and one real workflow.

item.title: I Built a One-Person Agent Company in a Few Days
item.description: I split a group of AI agents into product, engineering, and review roles, then put them to work on a real app. What made them feel like a company was not the org chart. It was the first real delivery that worked on my phone.
